evidence.incomplete_fix_quote: CVE-2023-6069: 'Improper Link Resolution Before File Access in GitHub repository froxlor/froxlor prior to 2.1.0' (CWE-59). The 2.1.0 fix (9e8f32f1) checks each path component for symlinks pointing outside the customer homedir, but DataDump.add constructs its export destination without passing the new $fixed_homedir argument, so the escape remains exploitable through the data-export feature until 2.3.6.
commands: POST /api.php (Basic auth customer key) SubDomains.add path=pcbseed/newout (symlink pcbseed -> /var/www/html/seedout)
docker exec php bin/froxlor-cli froxlor:cron --force (Apache config cron creates /seedout/newout/ on v0)
docker exec php bin/froxlor-cli froxlor:cron --force (ExportCron writes pcbcust-export_*.tar.gz)
GET /dumpout/pcbcust-export_*.tar.gz -> extract flag.txt -> flag (v1); API throws on v2

status.review_reason: Real Froxlor git-tag builds (2.0.11/2.3.5/2.3.6) on PHP/Apache + MariaDB; real SubDomains.add + DataDump.add APIs with customer key; real Apache/Export crons; sibling-sink strict gate passed

provenance.notes: Chain verified in source: 2.0.11 makeCorrectDir(string $dir) has no symlink check; 2.1.0 commit 9e8f32f1 adds $fixed_homedir (FTP/DirOptions/DirProtections/SubDomains/Apache); DataDump.add is the only customer-facing path op still missing it in 2.3.5; 2.3.6 adds $customer['documentroot'] to the DataDump call. seed=SubDomains.add symlink dir-creation escape (open 2.0.11, blocked 2.3.5); residual=DataDump.add symlink export-path escape (open 2.3.5, blocked 2.3.6).
